provenance: Five implementation-authored educational notes, not published academic papers; seven authored diagnostic queries. CC0 fixture text. Filenames are fixture metadata, not claims that files were uploaded. Page metadata validity is tested separately using actual generated PDF bytes.

chunks.title: Authored methods notes
chunks.text: Dropout randomly masks neural network activations during training. During evaluation masking is disabled. This regularization technique was studied by Srivastava and colleagues in 2014.

chunks.title: Authored methods notes
chunks.text: Principal component analysis uses centered data and orthogonal directions of maximum variance. Singular value decomposition provides principal components and explained variance.

chunks.title: Authored methods notes
chunks.text: BM25 is a lexical retrieval scoring method. It combines inverse document frequency with saturated term frequency and document length normalization.

chunks.title: Authored methods notes
chunks.text: A held out test split estimates performance after model selection. Hyperparameters are selected using training and validation data, not the held out test split.

chunks.title: Authored methods notes
chunks.text: Weight decay penalizes large parameter magnitudes. Decoupled weight decay in AdamW separates the decay update from the adaptive gradient update.
